description: This is a unit test class for the BuzzLikeOnShare entity within the OrangeHRM system, specifically testing the creation and property setting of the BuzzLikeOnShare entity in the context of the Buzz plugin. It initializes fixtures, mocks services, creates entity objects, and asserts their properties.

classes.name: BuzzLikeOnShareTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class for testing the BuzzLikeOnShare entity, including setup, data population, mocking, entity creation, and assertions.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test fixtures and resets database tables before each test execution.

methods.name: testEntity
methods.description: Tests the creation and property assignment of the BuzzLikeOnShare entity, including mocked current time set to '2022-11-03 19:20', and verifies the entity's properties with assertions.
